contracts.statement: A merchant's route decision must be causally driven by a legally obtained observation or belief update about route danger. The routeBeliefs for the bandit's road must have been raised by the observation (source === 'observation'), and the merchant's chosen route must avoid the bandit's road from tick 2 onward when the merchant's perceptionAccuracy is 1 and the bandit's is 0.
contracts.rationale: Constitution §161 EMERGENT CHAIN TEST 4 (BANDIT ADAPTATION) and Guardian V3 §3 require the cat-and-mouse dynamic to be information-driven, not ground-truth-driven. The merchant must react to the bandit's presence via a legal observation channel, not by reading the bandit's authoritative hidden location directly.

contracts.statement: The closed-world causal chain must be both ordered and parent-linked. One-shot: runClosedWorldScenario must emit CONVOY_FORMED, BANDIT_ATTACK, RUMOR, ROUTE_SELECTED, FACTION_REASSESSMENT, FACTION_ACTION, INVASION, BANDIT_RELOCATION in that relative order (membership/toContain is not sufficient; the order encodes the causal narrative attack → rumor → route → reassess → action → invasion → relocation; other system events such as LAW_VIOLATED legitimately interleave). Driven reducer: every event's parentEventIds must resolve to emitted events, and the required causal edges must hold — OBSERVATION → BELIEF_UPDATE → MERCHANT_ROUTE_DECISION → TRIP_COMMITMENT → ROUTE_EXPOSURE → CANDIDATE_ENCOUNTER → ENCOUNTER → CONSEQUENCE → FACTION_REACTION — so a merchant that held a belief must name the BELIEF_UPDATE parent on its route decision.
contracts.rationale: Constitution §53/§161 require the causal chain to be traceable. A reordered event stream breaks causal provenance, and an edge-cleared stream breaks the V8 causal-parentage contract. Guardian V3 §1 item #2 explicitly named the weakening from toEqual to toContain; the V4 P0 resolution (2026-10-18) additionally binds the edge-level requirement of MUT-CHAIN-001 (legalInformationSource: event causal parents), whose registry statement requires every link from OBSERVATION to FACTION REACTION to be preserved on the live reducer.

contracts.statement: Simulation.runClosedWorldStep must invoke the canonical reducer (tickClosedWorld) exactly once per step. The production runtime path IS the canonical path; no test-only manual bridge is allowed. V4 §7.2 emission segment: the canonical reducer must emit the authoritative decision mix — FACTION_REASSESSMENT on escalation change and FACTION_ACTION only behind a same-tick authorizing gate event; every INVASION must name the FACTION_ACTION that caused it. RUMOR creation is scenario-setup-scoped (rootReason SCENARIO_SETUP), not part of the canonical tick loop.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §4 Movement C §C2: 'Prove there is exactly one authoritative simulation advancement path per intended tick. Detect: double ticking, helper + reducer duplicate execution, stale wrappers, test-only entry paths.' V4 MOVEMENT C2 (2026-10-18) formalizes the at-least-once half as the exact-once tick phase: the canonical call site must exist and run in production, and it must be the only one. V4 P0 §7.2 resolution (2026-10-18): the live reducer demonstrably emits FACTION_REASSESSMENT and gate-authorised FACTION_ACTION, and the single createRumor call site lives in scenario setup (closed-world.js applySurvivorEvidence, reached only from runClosedWorldScenario); the canonical tick loop has no rumor source. Resolved as a spec revision with evidence rather than a new mechanic.

contracts.statement: Migration pressure must be driven by recent BANDIT_ATTACK events (within a 5-tick window). In a peaceful world with no recent attacks, the JusticeSystem's migration pressure must drop below 0.5 and no MIGRATION events must fire. A periodic MIGRATION from baseline JusticeSystem values is a P0 defect.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §8 Movement F §F1: 'No invisible duplication. No disappearing cargo.' Guardian V3 §1 item 3: migration fired on a fixed timer with no push factor.
preconditions: JusticeSystem.resolve() called per tick
BANDIT_ATTACK events may or may not have occurred recently
mechanism: BANDIT_ATTACK → reportedCrime (5-tick window) → grievance accumulation → migration pressure
forbidden: JusticeSystem.resolve() produces migration pressure > 0.5 from baseline values when reportedCrime is false
reportedCrime is sticky once any attack ever happened
contracts.observableConsequence: low-pressure world produces 0 MIGRATION events; high-pressure world (recent BANDIT_ATTACK within 5 ticks) produces > 0 MIGRATION events
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: directional comparison (low vs high pressure) + planted-defect (remove the 5-tick window → low-pressure fires migrations)
